entities.name: Sorin's Restoration
entities.description: Event in 4559 AR in the Valley of the Spirit Dragon on Tarkir that revived Ugin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker and ancient ally of Ugin, one of the three original Eldrazi jailors.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Ancient spirit dragon planeswalker, mortally wounded by Nicol Bolas and revived by Sorin.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who altered Tarkir's past, preserving Ugin and Tarkir's dragons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who mortally wounded Ugin and used Sarkhan to release the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Lithomancer and one of the three original jailors of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Valley of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Deep canyon on Tarkir holding Ugin's hedron-wrapped body.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane from which the Eldrazi escaped.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient threat that escaped on Zendikar.

events.summary: Sorin returns to Tarkir to find Ugin and arrives at the Haven of the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: Sorin Markov returned to Tarkir to find his ancient ally, Ugin.

events.summary: Sorin breaks the hedron seal with his lifeblood and ancient magic and collapses the cocoon with a spell of Unmaking; Ugin is revived.
events.quote: Ugin burst forth, alive once more

events.summary: Ugin confronts Sorin and orders him to find Nahiri and bring her to Zendikar to rebind the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Ugin ordered Sorin to find Nahiri and bring her to Zendikar.

events.summary: Sarkhan meets Ugin and explains how he changed Tarkir's fate; they piece together how Bolas used Sarkhan.
events.quote: Ugin and Sarkhan pieced together how Nicol Bolas had used Sarkhan to help release the Eldrazi

events.summary: Freed in mind, Sarkhan takes wing as a dragon; Ugin departs for Zendikar and Tarkir's dragonstorms lessen.
events.quote: With his mind freed at last, Sarkhan took wing as a dragon

relations.quote: Sorin Markov returned to Tarkir to find his ancient ally, Ugin.
who had been mortally wounded by Nicol Bolas centuries earlier
